notes.summary: Algebra in SSC is about identities: squares, cubes, and the x + 1/x family. 2–3 questions in Tier 1 and 2–4 in Tier 2. Learn the identities and you can solve most in under a minute.

concepts.title: Square identities
concepts.body: (a + b)<sup>2</sup> = a<sup>2</sup> + 2ab + b<sup>2</sup>; (a − b)<sup>2</sup> = a<sup>2</sup> − 2ab + b<sup>2</sup>; a<sup>2</sup> − b<sup>2</sup> = (a + b)(a − b); (a + b + c)<sup>2</sup> = a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup> + 2(ab + bc + ca).

concepts.title: Cube identities
concepts.body: a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup> = (a + b)<sup>3</sup> − 3ab(a + b). a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup> + c<sup>3</sup> − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup> − ab − bc − ca). If a + b + c = 0 then a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup> + c<sup>3</sup> = 3abc.

concepts.title: x + 1/x family
concepts.body: If x + 1/x = k: x<sup>2</sup> + 1/x<sup>2</sup> = k<sup>2</sup> − 2 and x<sup>3</sup> + 1/x<sup>3</sup> = k<sup>3</sup> − 3k.

varieties.name: Square identities
varieties.how: Pick the identity that links what is given to what is asked.

example.q: If a − b = 3 and ab = 10, find a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup>.

varieties.name: x + 1/x type
varieties.how: Square or cube the given expression.

varieties.name: Cubes and three variables
varieties.how: Use a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup> + c<sup>3</sup> − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup> − ab − bc − ca).

example.q: If a + b = 5 and ab = 6, find a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup>.

tips: If x = a + √b with a<sup>2</sup> − b = 1, then 1/x = a − √b.
Try putting simple values (like a = b = c) to check options quickly.

formulas.name: a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc
formulas.expr: (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca)

questions.q: If x + 1/x = 5, then the value of x<sup>2</sup> + 1/x<sup>2</sup> is:
If a + b = 10 and ab = 21, then a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> is:
If a + b + c = 0, then a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup> + c<sup>3</sup> is equal to:
questions.solution:
a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = (a + b + c)(…) = 0.
So a3 + b3 + c3 = 3abc.
